_comment: Placeholder, non-secret values only. Real ConnectionStrings/Redis values for local dev go in `dotnet user-secrets set` (run from backend/src/Siri.Api) — never in this file. See .claude/rules/backend.md and CLAUDE.md rule 9.

VirusScan._comment: No virus-scanning engine is integrated yet. Default everywhere else is Required (attachment uploads answer 503 attachment.virus_scanner_not_configured). Development explicitly opts in to Disabled so instructors can still test uploads locally; every such file is logged as NOT scanned. Production refuses to boot with Disabled.

Email._comment: Development delivers real SMTP to the local Mailpit capture server (127.0.0.1:1025, inbox at http://localhost:8025) — the same settings scripts/dev.ps1 passes. Plain SMTP is allowed here only because this is Development (rejected elsewhere). If Mailpit is not running, sends fail loudly and the outbox retries; nothing is silently dropped.

Jwt._comment: Same CHANGE_ME_DEV_ONLY_ non-secret placeholder convention as appsettings.json, deliberately a different random value so Development never silently shares a key with the base config.

Seed._comment: P0-37 dev/test bootstrap accounts — see appsettings.json's Identity:Seed comment. Set real AdminPassword/TestUserPassword via dotnet user-secrets before running --seed for real.

Payment._comment: Deliberately EMPTY (no fake keys): payment endpoints answer 503 payment.provider_not_configured until real Stripe TEST keys are set via `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or .env — never in this file.

VideoProvider._comment: Deliberately EMPTY (no fake ids/keys): upload/status/playback answer 503 video.provider_not_configured until real Bunny Stream settings are set via `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or .env — never in this file.
